other_exits: Basket close in profit: SumProfitPlus >= LevelProfitClosePlus (Side_By_Side mode closes Plus side, Both_Sides closes both, Hybrid modes combine)
Basket close in loss: SumProfitPlus <= LevelLossClosePlus (Whole_Side, Partial_Side, or Not_Close_In_Loss modes)
Close_Immediately_All_Orders operation mode closes all positions regardless of P&L
Close_In_Profit_And_Stop operation mode closes profitable positions then stops
Delay counters (DelayCloseProfit, DelayCloseLoss ticks) before executing close to confirm

params.fair_lot_size: UseFairLotSize adjusts level calculations to equalize per-pair exposure

position_sizing.conditional_logic: AutoLotSize=true uses RiskFactor*margin calculation; false uses ManualLotSize. Lot progression multiplies each subsequent grid level: Statical=constant, Geometrical=increasing sum, Exponential=doubling, Decreases=shrinking

custom_logic_notes: This is a multi-currency couple hedging EA. It takes 3-5 currencies (e.g. EUR/GBP/USD) and generates all possible pair combinations (3→3 groups, 4→12 groups, 5→30 groups). Each group is a 'couple' of 2 pairs sharing a common currency. The hedge logic: Plus side opens correlated directions (both BUY or BUY/SELL if pairs share base currency), Minus side opens opposite. Grid/martingale progression: when floating loss exceeds LevelOpenNext threshold, new orders open with increased lot size (geometrical/exponential progression). Close logic is basket-based: entire side or both sides close when combined profit reaches target. Delay counters in ticks prevent premature closes. MinutesForNextOrder enforces time gap between grid entries. Session control blocks trading Monday open (WaitAfterOpen minutes) and Friday close (StopBeforeClose minutes). Groups can be skipped by user via NoOfGroupToSkip parameter. Operation modes: Stand_by, Normal, Close_In_Profit_And_Stop, Close_Immediately_All_Orders.
python_conversion_notes: Requires multi-symbol tick data for all generated pairs simultaneously. Must implement PositionSelect-by-symbol logic across multiple symbols. Grid/martingale progression with geometrical/exponential multipliers is complex. Basket P&L calculation across 2 pairs per group with commission tracking needed. Delay-tick close confirmation requires tick-level simulation. Session time filtering with SymbolInfoSessionTrade is MT5-specific. Magic number grouping for position identification is essential. Symbol prefix/suffix auto-detection is broker-specific. Not recommended for simple Python conversion - would need a full multi-symbol backtesting framework with position management, margin checking, and cross-symbol hedging logic.
